newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia declares Piedemonte oil field commercial.
newsitem.headline: Colombia declares Piedemonte oil field commercial.

text.p: Energy and Mines Minister Rodrigo Villamizar said Tuesday that the government had declared the sprawling Piedemonte oil field in Colombia's eastern plains commerical.
Villamizar, who made the announcement in remarks to reporters, did not give details.
But he said his office had given its final approval to exploit the field, which has three hydrocarbon formations, after the state oil company Ecopetrol requested that it do so last week.
Ecopetrol operates the field, which Villamizar said has between 400 and 500 million barrels of oil or its equivalent in condensates in reserves, together with Britain's British Petroleum Co Plc.

BP has complained that potential profit margins on the field are not sufficient. But Villamizar said an ongoing dispute between the government and BP, over terms of its so-called sliding scale contract, had been partly resolved earlier this year when the government redefined terms of the contract to boost its short-term profitability for BP.
